headline: Biden order directs federal agencies to improve how they collect, share, and use data to respond to COVID-19 and future major health threats.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this executive order focuses on how the federal government gathers and uses public health data. It aims to guide the response to COVID-19 and to future serious public health threats using that data. No official summary was provided, so the specific steps and requirements are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies involved in public health
who_it_affects.how: They would likely be directed to change how they collect, share, and use health data related to COVID-19 and similar threats.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 21, 2021; executive orders generally take effect when signed unless they state otherwise.
